Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing spas to serve wine to their customers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing spas to serve wine to their customerswho are twentyone years of age or older; and adding new sections tochapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this title applies to or prevents a spa from offering orsupplying without charge wine by the individual glass to a customer forconsumption on the premises. However, the customer must be at leasttwentyone years of age and may only be offered one glass of wine, andthe wine must be purchased under this title.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board may adopt rules to implement section 1 of this act.
